exposure: fever in the two weeks prior to the survey
cohort: 24,529 children aged 0-59 months in Nigeria from the 2013 Nigeria Demographic and Health Survey (NDHS)
finding: Geopolitical zone (North East, North West and North Central), perceived birth size (small and average), male sex, home delivery and non-caesarean delivery, and fever in the two weeks prior to the survey were associated with wasting/severe wasting and underweight/severe underweight.
mod_finding: Home delivery and non-caesarean delivery were associated with wasting/severe wasting and underweight/severe underweight.
